svg.title: Caldari–Gallente warzone: 90 systems, 22 September 2026 before downtime
svg.desc: Official 2D positions, 110 internal gate links. Blue is Caldari occupancy and green Gallente. Orange rings indicate frontlines derived from internal adjacency. External routes are not drawn.

g.text: ESI cache last modified 2026-09-22 05:11 UTC · inherited SDE 3528119 geometry
All 90 stars retain CCP schematic coordinates under one uniform scale and Y reflection.
31 outgoing gates lead outside this diagram. Control is occupancy, not a blockade or a claim of current corporation ownership.
